impact.text: When splitting, the split part calculates the bonus again, resulting in repeated calculation of the bonus.

precondition_sources.text: The locked position being split is of SMNFT type.
The total amount of the original locked position (newLocked.amount) already includes the bonus.

intent_sources.text: When splitting an SMNFT locked position, the split amount should be the corresponding proportion of the original locked position amount, splitting _locked.amount directly proportionally without recalculating the reward.
